title: Split
subtitle: Ancient City by the Sea
summary: Split blended everyday life with nearly two thousand years of history. Ancient Roman walls surrounded lively cafés, narrow streets, and waterfront promenades, creating a city that felt both timeless and wonderfully alive.
heroImageAlt: The waterfront and historic center of Split, Croatia
homepageSummary: Walk through a living Roman palace where history, local culture, and the Adriatic Sea come together.

quote.text: Split reminded us that history doesn't have to be behind museum glass. Here, people still live inside it every day.

highlights.title: Diocletian's Palace
highlights.description: One of the world's most remarkable Roman structures still serving as the heart of a modern city.

highlights.title: Riva Promenade
highlights.description: Split's waterfront is lined with cafés, palm trees, and beautiful Adriatic views.

highlights.title: Cathedral of Saint Domnius
highlights.description: Originally built as Emperor Diocletian's mausoleum, it later became one of the world's oldest cathedrals.

highlights.title: Old Town
highlights.description: Stone alleys, hidden courtyards, and centuries of history make every walk feel like an exploration.

tips.title: Explore on foot
tips.description: The historic center is compact and rewards slow exploration.

tips.title: Spend time on the waterfront
tips.description: The Riva offers a relaxing place to enjoy the city's atmosphere.

tips.title: Look upward
tips.description: Many of Split's architectural details are easy to miss unless you slow down and look around.

tips.title: Allow time to wander
tips.description: Some of the city's most memorable discoveries happen away from the busiest streets.
